todos: [P2] ONLYRAG-LAYOUT-V2-LIVE-01: The .onlyrag v2 layout is implemented for every Agent Coding workspace: per-chat SHA-256 state/tracker, backed-up resumable legacy migration, owned checkpoints, internal file-tool protection, and project removal that preserves local data. On 2026-09-28, npm run test:fast passed (279 files, 2212 tests); typecheck, quality:static and docs:check passed. In the next desktop npm run dev session, open an existing legacy project and a new empty project, confirm migration/readback and .onlyrag initialization before the first run, then delete one chat and reopen a removed project. Arbitrary shell commands can still access .onlyrag under the existing command policy; no live Ollama run was performed for this refactor.

[P2] SIDECAR-OFFLINE-DEV-01: In npm run dev the user observed LanceDB Sidecar Offline. The dependency probe in sidecarProcessManager now imports rapidocr (matching the installed RapidOCR 3 package) instead of rapidocr_onnxruntime; the fast suite passes, but Sidecar startup in a real dev session was not checked. Next session: start npm run dev, inspect Sidecar startup/health and the exact error if it remains Offline, then verify a LanceDB-backed action without changing RAG storage.

[P2] LIVE-MODEL-HARDWARE-01: Run live Coding Agent qualification with recent Ollama models sized for the available NVIDIA RTX 2070 8 GiB and 32 GiB RAM. Start with the installed qwen3.5:4b (3.4 GB); compare qwen3.5:2b (2.7 GB) and consider qwen3.5:9b (6.6 GB) only if measured VRAM and context leave room. The current live harness hardcodes qwen3.8:27b: make the model selectable per run without changing saved app settings, then use the same isolated prompt and realistic 8K-16K context for each candidate. Record GPU/CPU residency (ollama ps, nvidia-smi), prompt and generation speed, tool-call correctness, milestones, verification, and terminal status; stop slow offloaded runs early. Select a usable default from measured results and keep snapshots only while needed for diagnosis. Model source: https://ollama.com/library/qwen3.5 .

[P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: qwen3.8:27b full-task qualification remains open. A 65536-context run reached 8/8 but closure timed out; another stopped at 0/8. In the later 32768-context thinking-off run, three native tool calls completed after 1247, 1242 and 1356 seconds, but the user stopped the run at step 25/50 with 2/9 milestones verified. Ollama ps showed 79% CPU / 21% GPU and about 1.8-2 token/s on full-task calls. The interrupted workspace and snapshot remain under %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live because automatic approval review blocked cleanup on 2026-09-27. Do not resume them automatically; evaluate smaller modern models first (LIVE-MODEL-HARDWARE-01).

[P2] AGENT-THINKING-RUNAWAY-01: Reasoning budget code and tests are complete; live budget enforcement remains unconfirmed. The 2026-09-27 qwen3.8 full-task run used thinking off, so it cannot exercise the 18-minute reasoning cut. Confirm on a thinking-model run that crosses the budget; retain the current transport tests and two-cut termination guard.

[P2] QWEN25-CODER-JSON-TOOL-LIVE-01: Coding Agent Studio qwen2.5-coder:7b emitted exact JSON tool envelopes in content instead of native tool_calls and stopped at model_silence. The narrowly scoped envelope recovery is implemented and passed unit, fast, typecheck and Electron E2E tests; a live compatibility probe wrote hello.txt. The original full prompt has not been rerun in the rebuilt desktop app. The user deleted C:\Users\Utente\Desktop\test_app and wants the app created from scratch in the next session. The app request covered a responsive Dashboard and Tasks UI, sidebar/drawer navigation, adding and completing persistent tasks, and future service folders for MongoDB, Redis, Nuvolaris OpenServerless and TodoWrite. Rebuild the desktop app, rerun the original prompt in that empty workspace and verify the complete agent path.

[P2] AGENT-MILESTONE-SEQUENCE-LIVE-01: The planner, update_plan gate, mutation credit, verification promotion and checklist now advance only the first open milestone; unit and fast checks cover the rule; Electron reliability E2E passes but does not assert the sequence. A desktop Ollama run has not yet confirmed the visible pending -> in_progress -> verified sequence on a real approved plan, including a restored plan with overlapping in_progress states. Verify in the next full-task run without resuming the interrupted qwen3.8 workspace automatically.

[P2] AGENT-ACTIVE-RUN-LIVE-01: Mode and context-window updates are wired through UI, IPC and the orchestrator, with unit and loop tests. Electron reliability E2E does not change Guided/Auto/Ask or num_ctx during generation. Confirm in the desktop app that the next turn uses the chosen mode and context, that Guided-only review resolves on Auto, that network/install consent stays pending, and that queued or completed runs are unaffected.

[P3] AGENT-DEV-SERVER-TOOL-01: User chose three public agent tools on 2026-09-27: start a managed background dev server, probe local HTTP, stop the owned process. Limit them to the current workspace and localhost. The user then asked to stop the session before implementation. Existing run_command correctly blocks non-exiting dev/watch commands. Inspect tool callers, consumers and verification paths before changing the public interface.

[P3] I18N-TRACKER-LIVE-01: Format-2 SESSION_TRACKER.md is reread into the changing focus-turn context; integration test passes. The interrupted 2026-09-27 live audit showed completed_tasks containing m-1 in prompts at steps 16, 19 and 21. The run then marked m-4 verified, but stopped before a later turn could prove that newly changed completed_tasks and unresolved_issues were consumed. Confirm in a new live run; the prior snapshot remains at %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\interrupted-ctx32k-timeoutfix-20260927.

[P3] I18N-SIDECAR-MIGRATION-LIVE-01: Isolated nonempty LanceDB validation passed on 2026-09-27 with Ollama nomic-embed-text: preview counted 1 legacy chunk, --apply migrated it, the vector and metadata matched, the current chunk stayed unchanged, and offline backup rollback restored both rows. The actual app userData still has no chunks table; confirm on the first real nonempty legacy corpus when available.

[P3] LIVE-RUN-RESIDUE-CLEANUP-01: The user requested removal of old live-run residues in %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live, including workspaces, audit logs, runs, snapshots and the isolated migration fixture. All eight top-level children were inventoried and no live run was active, but automatic approval review rejected the verified-path recursive Remove-Item command on 2026-09-27 (blocked by policy). The files remain; remove only these known test-only paths when the environment permits, without touching app userData or Ollama models.

[P3] SIDECAR-CANCELLATION-STATE-01: sidecar/services/task_cancellation.py uses setdefault in cancel_task so cancel-before-register works, but IDs that never register remain in the process-wide _tasks map and the endpoint reports success for them. Add bounded cleanup or expiry while preserving the early-cancellation race; cover unknown-ID and repeated-cancel behavior in Sidecar tests.

[P3] LEGACY-SESSION-COMPAT-01: agentOrchestratorSessionState.ts still accepts identity-free pre-run plan seeds, and sessionHistoryRepository.ts migrates standalone sessions from the fallback store. These paths are intentional compatibility, not dead code. Inventory persisted user data and define a safe migration/removal point before deleting either path; avoid keeping them indefinitely without evidence of need.

[P3] REACT-ACT-WARNING-01: npm run test:fast passes but useTranslationHooks.test.tsx emits React act(...) warnings in the swaps the language pair case. Trace the asynchronous state update and wrap the responsible operation in act so test output remains reliable.
